name: Kentucky
agency: Kentucky Transportation Cabinet (licensing, drive.ky.gov); Kentucky State Police Driver Testing (written and road tests)
permitAge: 15 (KRS 186.450, amended by HB 15, effective 2025-03-25; manual p. 5)

teen.supervisedHours: 60 hours, including 10 at night, on a Practice Driving Log signed by a parent or guardian (manual pp. 5-6; KRS 186.452)
teen.holdPermit: 180 days for applicants under 21; 30 days for applicants 21 and older (manual pp. 5, 8, 9; KRS 186.450). Intermediate license at 16 or older (KRS 186.452); full license at 17 or older after 180 days on the intermediate license and driver education (KRS 186.454)
teen.nightLimit: Permit and intermediate license under 18: no driving midnight to 6 a.m. without good cause (school, work, emergency) (manual pp. 5-6; KRS 186.450, 186.452)
teen.passengerLimit: Permit and intermediate license under 18: no more than one unrelated passenger under 20, unless a driver training instructor is present (manual pp. 5, 7; KRS 186.452)
teen.phone: Drivers under 18 (permit, intermediate or operator license): no personal communication device use while moving, except to call for help in an emergency (KRS 189.294; not stated in the manual)

notes: Checked 2026-10-09 against the KSP Kentucky Driver Manual updated 7-23-26 (81-page PDF, printed page = PDF page minus 8). The older 10-11-2023 manual is superseded.
Pass mark 80 percent (manual p. 11). The manual and KSP driver-testing page do not give the number of questions; left null.

Written test languages (manual p. 11): 26 languages including Spanish, Arabic, Chinese and Vietnamese; Arabic, Burmese, Chinese, French, Japanese, Somali and Spanish are on the testing software and in audio. KSP page lists a shorter set and says it is for the standard operator test only. Tagalog and Haitian Creole are not listed. The signs part must be answered from the applicant's own knowledge when the test is given orally.
Spanish manual (KSP, dated 09-08-2023) is older than the English one.

Manual errors versus statute: p. 6 says intermediate license after 180 days and age 17; KRS 186.452 (effective 2025-03-25) says age 16. Pp. 8-9 say the permit is valid three years; KRS 186.450(3)(a) says four years since HB 15 (2025). Questions follow the statute.

School bus (manual p. 44; KRS 189.370 as amended by 2026 Ky. Acts ch. 62, effective 2026-07-15): stop from either direction on all roads, except opposite-direction traffic on a road of four or more lanes divided by an elevated barrier or unpaved median.
Move over (manual p. 66): change to a lane not next to a stopped emergency vehicle if safe, otherwise slow down.
Speed (manual p. 49; KRS 189.390): 65 mph interstates and parkways, 55 other state highways, 35 business/residential, 15 public parking lots; 70 mph allowed on listed interstate and parkway segments.
